page.title: Transactions
page.description: Every euro in, out, and moved between your accounts.

empty.title: Nothing recorded yet
empty.description: Add a transaction by hand, or bring in a bank export from the Import page.
empty.filteredMessage: No transactions match these filters. Try widening the period or clearing a chip above.

deleteConfirm.title: Delete this transaction?
deleteConfirm.description: “{{description}}” will be removed from your ledger. Balances recalculate immediately and this cannot be undone.

deleteLinkedConfirm.title: This transaction is linked
deleteLinkedConfirm.descriptionDebt: It’s recorded as a payment on “{{name}}”.
deleteLinkedConfirm.descriptionRecurring: It’s recorded as a payment for “{{name}}”.
deleteLinkedConfirm.descriptionBoth: It’s linked to debt “{{debt}}” and recurring expense “{{recurring}}”.
deleteLinkedConfirm.question: Should deleting it also undo that payment progress?
deleteLinkedConfirm.keepProgressHint: Keeps the debt/recurring payment; only removes the ledger row.
deleteLinkedConfirm.undoProgressHint: Reverses the debt balance or rewinds the recurring due date and removes the payment record.

toast.deleteError: Could not delete the transaction. Try again.

description.transfer: Move money between two of your own accounts. It affects both balances and neither budget.
description.income: Record money arriving in an account.
description.expense: Record money leaving an account, against a spending category.

toast.debtLinkFailed: Transaction saved, but the debt payment could not be linked
toast.recurringLinkFailed: Transaction saved, but the recurring expense link failed
toast.trackersFailed: Transaction saved, but the trackers could not be updated

links.debtHint: Records a payment against the selected debt without creating a second transaction.
links.recurringHint: Marks this as a payment for the selected bill or subscription.

trackers.label: Trackers
trackers.hint: File this transaction under one or more trackers.

split.lockedHint: Amount is set by your bank and can't be edited.
split.help: Split the {{total}} {{currency}} across categories. The parts must add up to the original.

markTransfer.title: Mark as transfer
markTransfer.description: Tag this synced transaction as a transfer to another account instead of income or an expense.
markTransfer.candidateHint: This account is also synced from your bank — pick its matching row for the same transfer. Neither balance will change.
markTransfer.noCandidates: No matching transaction found on that account for this amount.
markTransfer.manualHint: {{account}} isn't bank-synced, so its balance will be updated to reflect this transfer.

toast.error: Couldn't update this transaction. Try again.

columns.pendingHint: Not yet booked by your bank. It may change or disappear.

description.expense: Pick the payments in which friends paid you back for this expense. Only the part you really paid counts in your totals.
description.income: Pick the shared expense this payment paid back. The linked part stops counting as income.

summary.income: {{total}} received · {{linked}} used to pay back · {{counted}} counted as income

emptyHint.expense: Paid for others too? Link the repayments they sent you, so only your share counts.
emptyHint.income: A friend paying you back? Link it to the shared expense, so it doesn't count as income.

toast.error: Couldn't update the link. Try again.

documents.title: Documents
documents.keepOpen: Keep this window open until attachment is complete.
documents.sentToPaperless: Document sent to Paperless for processing
documents.processingError: Paperless could not process the document
